_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "companies" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "business_types" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "iban" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "tax_info" TEXT NULL, "intro_text" TEXT NULL, "payment_terms" TEXT NULL, "delivery_time" TEXT NULL, "warranty_terms" TEXT NULL, "logo_path" TEXT NULL, "has_logo" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("has_logo" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "users" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES companies (id), "full_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "email" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "phone" TEXT NULL, "password_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OWNER', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES companies (id), "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "contact_name" TEXT NULL, "company_name" TEXT NULL, "iban" TEXT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'BIREYSEL', "phone" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "il" TEXT NULL, "ilce" TEXT NULL, "tax_info" TEXT NULL, "tax_certificate_path" TEXT NULL, "has_tax_certificate" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("has_tax_certificate" IN (0, 1)), "logo_path" TEXT NULL, "has_logo" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("has_logo" IN (0, 1)), "notes" TEXT NULL, "tags" TEXT NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "job_types" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES companies (id), "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_custom" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_custom" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "service_requests" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES companies (id), "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "priority" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NORMAL', "address" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'BEKLIYOR', "converted_job_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "jobs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES companies (id), "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "job_type_id" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "appointment_date" INTEGER NULL, "start_time" TEXT NULL, "end_time" TEXT NULL, "priority" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NORMAL', "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'TALEP', "technician_user_id" TEXT NULL, "estimated_price_minor" INTEGER NULL, "actual_price_minor" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "job_notes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "job_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES jobs (id), "note" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "job_photos" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "job_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES jobs (id), "category" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DIGER', "file_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "job_signatures" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "job_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES jobs (id), "signer_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "quotes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES companies (id), "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'TASLAK', "notes" TEXT NULL, "total_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "intro_text" TEXT NULL, "payment_terms" TEXT NULL, "delivery_time" TEXT NULL, "warranty_terms" TEXT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'TRY', "vat_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'EXCLUDED', "vat_rate" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 20, "valid_until" INTEGER NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "quote_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "quote_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES quotes (id), "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'adet', "unit_price_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "tax_rate" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 20, "discount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "discount_rate" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "proformas" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES companies (id), "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "valid_until" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "total_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "intro_text" TEXT NULL, "payment_terms" TEXT NULL, "delivery_time" TEXT NULL, "warranty_terms" TEXT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'TRY', "vat_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'EXCLUDED', "vat_rate" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 20, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "proforma_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "proforma_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES proformas (id), "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'adet', "unit_price_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "tax_rate" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 20, "discount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "discount_rate" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES companies (id), "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "job_id" TEXT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "method" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Nakit', "date" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "income_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES companies (id), "date" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NULL, "job_id" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Diğer', "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "method" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Nakit', "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expense_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES companies (id), "date" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Diğer', "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "vendor_name" TEXT NULL, "receipt_photo_path" TEXT NULL, "method" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Nakit', "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customer_ledger_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES companies (id), "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "entry_date" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reference_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "reference_id" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "products" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES companies (id), "barcode" TEXT NULL, "sku" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "brand" TEXT NULL, "model" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'adet', "purchase_price_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sale_price_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "current_stock" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "min_stock" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MANUAL', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_movements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES companies (id), "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id), "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reference_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "reference_id" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_operations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_version" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', "attempt_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
